Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.

Setting: Close natural observations of a seven-spotted ladybug life cycle on a green garden plant, seen over time. Adults have red wing covers with seven black spots, black head with pale side patches and six legs. Larvae are dark elongated six-legged forms with orange markings; pupae are fixed to a leaf.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): One green plant with broad leaves; A small cluster of upright yellow eggs; Natural ladybug larva, pupa and adult stages; Tiny green aphids

Show only the people, objects and development stage required below.
